finding: Firebase CLI 15.9.1 returned success for --only firestore:rules,storage while the Firestore array configuration selected no database. Storage was deployed, but the named Firestore release was unchanged.

verificationBeforeRecovery.missingScope: Only eatCleanDriverChanges and eatCleanWorkspaceChanges authorized get matches differed from the tested source; other rules were identical.

prevention: Select both the named database and the rules-only modifier in the pinned Firebase CLI, preserving the separate create-only index workflow.
Read the exact named rules release and its ruleset, compare normalized source hashes, and reread release metadata to reject a concurrent deployment.
Fail deployment on wrong project/database, wrong source, extra source files, permission failure or source mismatch. Never infer rule deployment from CLI exit status alone.
Use the workflow deploy identity or the existing local Firebase identity; log only release metadata and hashes.

validation.existingRulesTests: The exact unchanged firestore.rules source passed 45 rule tests and hosted source CI for PR17 before the targeted recovery.

limits: No business request or synthetic production account was needed. Source matching proves the deployed ruleset, not observed customer traffic or a measured cost saving.
